title: OAEP execution receipt
description: Draft oaep/0.1 receipt (PRD §9). Level-0 is a signed agent claim. Hash, hex, JCS, Ed25519, and Merkle encodings are defined in docs/canonical.md. This schema still accepts any 0x-prefixed hex so older fixtures remain structurally valid. Produced values use SHA-256 (32 bytes) and Ed25519 signatures (64 bytes). This schema does not implement TEE/zk verification, a blockchain, or a hosted verifier.

version.description: Protocol version tag. Must be the string oaep/0.1 for this schema.

execution_id.description: Unique id for this execution. Produced values are SHA-256 commitments (docs/canonical.md).

agent.description: Executing agent identity (PRD §11). Receipts are signed by this agent.

task.description: Commitment to the task / user intent. Raw prompt is not required (PRD §25).

models.description: Models that participated. Empty if none. Item fields beyond identity are unstable (PRD §12).

tools.description: Tool invocations with input/output commitments (PRD §13). Raw I/O need not be public.

delegations.description: Child-agent receipts referenced by this parent (PRD §14). Reference encoding is unstable.

execution.description: When and where the agent ran. Environment string is unstable.

proofs.description: Optional attestations / proofs (PRD §15 levels 2–4). Shape is unstable; Level-0 does not require this array.

trace_root.description: Merkle root of the execution-event trace (PRD §10). Leaf/node encoding is in docs/canonical.md. Optional for Level-0 schema-only verify.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over JCS(receipt without signature). Produced values are 64 bytes (0x + 128 hex). See docs/canonical.md. The schema only requires a non-empty 0x-prefixed hex string.

hexBytes.description: 0x-prefixed hex. Produced SHA-256 values are 32 bytes; Ed25519 signatures are 64 bytes. See docs/canonical.md. Length is not constrained here so older fixtures remain structurally valid.

id.description: Cryptographic agent identity. This package uses did:agent:ed25519:<hex> (PRD §11). Other DID methods may appear.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, 0x-prefixed hex (32 bytes when produced). Optional if agent.id is did:agent:ed25519:<hex>. See docs/canonical.md.

version.description: Agent software / policy version string. Unstable.

commitment.description: Commitment to task input: SHA-256(preimage || nonce). Preimage is not part of the receipt (docs/canonical.md).

identity.description: Model identity commitment (SHA-256 digest when produced). See docs/canonical.md.

fingerprint.description: Optional model fingerprint (e.g. Sentient Model Fingerprinting). Unstable.

version.description: Model version or revision label. Unstable.

input_commitment.description: Commitment to tool input: SHA-256(preimage || nonce).

output_commitment.description: Commitment to tool output: SHA-256(preimage || nonce).

receipt.description: SHA-256 of the canonical child receipt (docs/canonical.md). Inline nested receipts are out of scope for this field.

commitment.description: Commitment to the produced output: SHA-256(preimage || nonce).

environment.description: Free-form execution environment label (runtime, TEE class, host). Unstable; not an attestation.

type.description: Proof / attestation class. Examples from the PRD: tee, remote_attestation, zkml, zkvm, signature, reproducible. Closed enum is deferred; this field is unstable.

proof.description: Opaque proof or attestation material. Encoding is unstable (string today; structured objects later).
